fields.value: Approximately 60 bpm (conditional mean-interval estimate). Retained positive-apex spacing is nearly uniform in this short window. Regular biphasic sharp complexes with step-like intercomplex baseline and multiple small pointed bumps; extra features near recovery. Recurring pointed features support testing an atrial-series interpretation, not preferentially selecting nonconduction or a block grade. A conducted atrial series, concealed/overlapping contour and nonatrial recovery features remain alternatives until identity and timing are resolved. Regular complexes near 60 coexist with recurring precomplex pointed features and another feature on rebound. Independent atrial identity/count is unresolved, particularly where the second feature could belong to QRS or recovery. No 2:1 ratio or block subtype is established. QRS duration remains withheld. PR remains withheld.
